title: In the 12 years of the Modi government, India has been rebuilt as a bastion of security that shields the citizens and unleashes destruction upon its enemies, says Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Home Affairs

In the 12 years of the Modi government, India has been rebuilt as a bastion of security that shields the citizens and unleashes destruction upon its enemies, says Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah

Through surgical strike, Operation Sindoor, abrogating Article 370, eradicating Naxalism, India has set examples of its resolute commitment to national security for the world to admire

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
17 JUN 2026 2:13PM by PIB Delhi

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation, Shri Amit Shah today highlighted the achievements of the Modi Government in strengthening national security over the past 12 years. Shri Shah said that in the 12 years of the Modi government, India has been rebuilt as
a bastion of security that shields the citizens and unleashes destruction upon its enemies.

In a post on X, Shri Amit Shah said, “
In the 12 years of the Modi government, our nation has been rebuilt as a bastion of security that shields the citizens and unleashes destruction upon its enemies. Whether it is responding to enemies across border with the firepower of surgical strike, air strike and Operation Sindoor, abrogating Article 370, eradicating Naxalism or fortifying internal security with over 12 accords in the Northeast, India has set examples of its resolute commitment to national security for the world to admire.
”
